_comment: FIXTURE manifest for Tools/check_txv_cards.py --self-test. ACCT.netsacrossaccounts is cited by no fixture card on purpose, to cover the unreferenced-id warning.

ACCT.netsacrossaccounts.statement: the variance nets to zero across the accounts the document touched, within tolerance

TLM.cardexonly.statement: LedgerAmount = 0 and CardexAmount <> 0 on the compare row

TLM.oneleg.statement: exactly one F4111 row with ildct 'IT' for (company, document)

TXI.pairpresent.statement: two F4111 rows with ildct 'IT' for (company, document)

TXI.pricedzero.statement: unit cost is zero on the transfer line
